behaviors.behavior: A bare @pytest.mark.covers("FR-XX.YY") tag still resolves exactly as before (AC#1)
canonical_fr_ac() resolves a bare FR to (fr_id, None) and an AC-scoped token to (fr_id, ac_id)
A pytest_marker tag naming FR-XX.YY/ACnn binds the test to that AC
A malformed AC suffix (e.g. /AC7, not zero-padded) invalidates the WHOLE tag, never falling back to a bare-FR hit
An AC-scoped tag produces a new acs node on the owning requirement, schema-valid under v4
An AC's per-layer coverage is 'ok' only when a filed link actually executed=pass
A bare-FR tag creates no acs node but still covers the parent FR
acs entries are ordered by AC number, not lexically (AC99 before AC100)
behaviors.evidence: `test_acs_are_sorted_by_ac_number_not_lexically` PASSED -- fixture rebuilt to AC99/AC100 (genuinely diverges under lexical vs numeric sort) after external code review (glm) found the original AC07/AC09 fixture vacuous for this claim

behaviors.behavior: A test carrying both a bare and an AC-scoped tag for the same FR merges into ONE parent link (ac_id backfilled), not duplicated
A test bound to TWO DIFFERENT ACs of the same FR does not let the parent link silently pick one ac_id; each AC's own bucket stays correct
